author: MiniWarGaming
description:
The war-torn battlefields of the Imperium become the stage for a clash of darkness and decay.

A force of Death Guard Plague Marines rampages across the front lines, spreading plague and pestilence in their wake. But their advance draws the attention of the Drukhari, who strike from the shadows to claim a prize left behind during the Imperium’s desperate retreat.

Though their actions may unintentionally aid the Imperium, the Drukhari have no interest in heroics, they care only to secure the mysterious element they seek. 

Join Luka and Skari for this 2,000-point 40K battle report between the Death Guard and Druhkari.
